```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const toggle = e.target.closest(".pub-toggle");
  if (toggle) {
    const abs = document.getElementById(toggle.getAttribute("aria-controls"));
    const open = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!open));
    abs.hidden = open;
    return;
  }
  const chip = e.target.closest(".filter-chips .chip");
  if (!chip) return;
  const f = chip.dataset.filter;
  document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chips .chip").forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle("active", c === chip));
  document.querySelectorAll(".pub").forEach((p) => {
    p.hidden = f !== "all" && !p.dataset.topics.split(" ").includes(f);
  });
  // Hide a section heading when none of its entries match
  document.querySelectorAll("section.pub-section").forEach((s) => {
    s.hidden = !s.querySelector(".pub:not([hidden])");
  });
});
</script>
```
